title: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least num
question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.

prediction.sql:
WITH list_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN,
    COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ml.IS_PUBLIC, ml.IS_HIDDEN
),
extrema AS (
  SELECT MAX(member_count) AS max_count, MIN(member_count) AS min_count
  FROM list_counts
),
list_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    o.OWNER
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
)
SELECT
  lc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  lo.OWNER,
  lc.IS_PUBLIC,
  lc.IS_HIDDEN,
  lc.member_count
FROM list_counts lc
JOIN list_owners lo ON lo.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
CROSS JOIN extrema e
WHERE lc.member_count = e.max_count OR lc.member_count = e.min_count
ORDER BY lc.member_count, lc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, lo.OWNER

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST, COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count, MIN(d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS earliest_update FROM `MOIRA_LIST` AS m JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS d ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY GROUP BY m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST HAVING COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 1) SELECT inner_cte.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, inner_cte.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST, inner_cte.member_count, inner_cte.earliest_update, ml.IS_PUBLIC FROM inner_cte JOIN `MOIRA_LIST` AS ml ON inner_cte.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, t0.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, t0.IS_PUBLIC, t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, t1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, MIN(t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY ORDER BY t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS min_mit_id FROM `MOIRA_LIST` AS t0 JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = t1.MOIRA_LIST_KEY WHERE t0.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND t0.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(list_key) OVER (ORDER BY list_key_sort, list_name_sort) = list_key THEN NULL ELSE list_key END AS list_key, list_name, is_public, member_full_name, member_mit_id, last_update_date, min_mit_id FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_KEY END AS list_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_KEY END AS list_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_NAME END AS list_name_sort, MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name, MAX(IS_PUBLIC) AS is_public, MAX(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME) AS member_full_name, MAX(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS member_mit_id, MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS last_update_date, MIN(min_mit_id) AS min_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY list_key_sort, list_name_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT os.DLC_KEY, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM OrgStats AS os JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON os.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.min_organization_number, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, CASE WHEN inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA >= 100000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA >= 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS building_size_category FROM inner_cte

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms, inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) AS sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.Total_Rooms, b.BUILDING_NAME, s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 'Large_Accessible_Room' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS Total_Rooms, s2.BUILDING_NAME, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 'Top_Building_Area_Range' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, Total_Rooms, BUILDING_NAME, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME, Reason

  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),

  SELECT MIN(member_count) AS min_cnt, MAX(member_count) AS max_cnt
  FROM list_counts
)
SELECT
  l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  o.OWNER,
  l.IS_PUBLIC,
  l.IS_HIDDEN,
  lc.member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST l
JOIN list_counts lc ON lc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE lc.member_count = b.min_cnt OR lc.member_count = b.max_cnt
GROUP BY l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, o.OWNER, l.IS_PUBLIC, l.IS_HIDDEN, lc.member_count
